title: BRUNKRISSLA comforter set
description: BRUNKRISSLA comforter set, black, Twin/Twin X-long Good quality that pays off in the long run. The checkered BRUNKRISSLA comforter in cotton/viscose is wonderfully soft and comfy. It’s also easy-care since it can be machine washed. Pillow sham with a closure in the middle of the back.
features: Comprises: 1 Twin/Twin XL size comforter 68x92''(173cmx234cm) and 1 Queen size pillow sham 20x30'' (51x72.3").
Thread count indicates the number of threads per square inch of fabric. The higher the thread count the more densely woven the fabric.
Filling density is measured in ounces per square yard. The higher the filling density, the fluffier and warmer the comforter.
The roll-packed, compressed comforter regains its original shape and fluffiness after a few days.
materialAndCare: Fabric: 54 % cotton, 46 % viscose/rayon; Filling: 100% polyester (min. 90% recycled)
